title: Use total_cmp for RootCandidate float comparison
description: In rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs line 762-768, RootCandidate::cmp() uses partial_cmp().unwrap_or(Equal) for comparing combined RF scores. This can violate Ord transitivity if NaN values appear. Replace with f32::total_cmp() which provides a total ordering including for NaN values.
close_reason: Fixed: Replaced partial_cmp().unwrap_or(Equal) with total_cmp() for f32 combined_score comparison in RootCandidate::cmp(). This ensures Ord transitivity compliance even when NaN values appear.
